# Fonts generated by tools/fonts/generate.sh. Kept in their own component so
# they are compiled as C (PlatformIO applies C++-only flags to C files in src/).
idf_component_register(
  SRCS font_bold_18.c font_bold_32.c font_bold_40.c icons_22.c icons_30.c icons_52.c
  INCLUDE_DIRS "."
  REQUIRES lvgl)
